 NBA rosters set for 2026-27 regular season
 The season opens with a Tuesday tripleheader: The Celtics visit the Pistons, the champion Knicks host the 76ers & the Thunder visit the Spurs.
 NBA.com Staff
 October 20, 2026 12:01 AM 
 Jalen Brunson will lead the Knicks against the 76ers on Opening Night at Madison Square Garden.
 NEW YORK – The 2026-27 NBA season begins Tuesday with an NBC/Peacock tripleheader as the Boston Celtics visit the Detroit Pistons ( 3 ET ), the defending NBA champion New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers ( 7 ET ), and the Oklahoma City Thunder visit the San Antonio Spurs meet the Oklahoma City Thunder at Frost Bank Center ( 9:30 ET ).
 Below are the opening night rosters for all 30 teams for  American Express NBA Tip-Off 2026 .
